title: Calling all robotics startups: apply to RoboBusiness Startup Alley
text:
## 事件
RoboBusiness 2026（2026年10月20-21日，加州圣克拉拉）启动Startup Alley申请，面向全球机器人初创公司开放免费10×10展位，截止日期为2026年8月12日。活动还将举办Pitchfire初创公司竞赛。

## 影响
该征集将吸引一批机器人系统、部件或软件初创公司参展，加速行业展示与投融资对接。短期提升机器人领域创业活跃度，但具体影响取决于最终入选公司及其展示的技术方向。

## 标的线索
暂无明确标的线索（活动为行业展会，未涉及具体公司或产品）。

## 待验证
- 最终入选Startup Alley的初创公司名单及其技术方向。
- 活动期间是否发布重要行业趋势或融资案例。

prompt_system:
你是「资讯雷达」投研向改写助手。任务：把用户提供的一篇资讯压成可读的投研草稿。

硬性要求：
1. 严格用下面四个中文小节标题（Markdown ##），顺序固定，每节 1-4 条短句：
## 事件
## 影响
## 标的线索
## 待验证
2. 只客观陈述；不推荐买卖；不预测涨跌；不构成投资建议。
3. 「标的线索」只能写可能相关的公司/板块/主题，并标注「待核实」；没有则写「暂无明确标的线索」。
4. 「待验证」写需要交叉核对的事实或缺口；没有则写「暂无」。
5. 不要输出前后缀寒暄、不要编造文中不存在的数字。

The event is looking for robotics startups to take part in its startup alley. Selected startups will get a free 10×10 booth on the RoboBusiness show floor. The deadline for submissions is August 12, 2026 . We’re looking for robotics startups that are creating an interesting full system, component, or software system to show off their work at the show. The startups will have the opportunity to network with other robotics and component developers, as well as investors. Select startups will also have the opportunity to participate in our Startup Showcase . These startups will have the opportunity to give a short presentation about their work on the Engineering Theater stage. This session will give startups further exposure to the RoboBusiness audience. RoboBusiness is the number one event for commercial robotics developers. Attendees will gain the latest insights from experts in robotics and AI on cutting-edge research, industry trends, and innovative applications in sectors such as manufacturing, healthcare, agriculture, logistics, and more. RoboBusiness has been the premier event for discussions around commercial robotics development and industry trends for 20 years. The event is also looking for investors and emerging startups to compete in the annual Pitchfire Robotics Startup Competition.
